name: whatsapp-mcp-workspace
description: Workspace root for the whatsapp-api service, its SDK, and the whatsapp-mcp consumer
//: Every entry point builds first. `whatsapp-api-sdk` exports `./dist/`, the same paths npm publish and `pnpm deploy --prod` resolve, so a tree that has never been built has nothing for `api` and `mcp` to typecheck, lint or import against. `api` and `mcp` also each build the SDK from their own `build:deps`, and `pnpm -r` runs those two concurrently: on an already-built tree the SDK's `tsc -b` makes both a no-op, but on a cold tree two compilers would emit into `packages/sdk/dist` at once and one could read the other's half-written `index.d.ts`. Building once up front is what keeps that from being reachable, which is why `check` calls `pnpm -r run lint`/`typecheck` directly rather than going through the wrapped `lint`/`typecheck` scripts and building three times.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run lint
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run test
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run format:check && pnpm -r run lint && pnpm -r run typecheck
